descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S05 Number edges: teens vs tens, leading zero, decimals, thousands, units

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Same setup as S01/S02, both contexts

When Speak each edge sentence into the pre-round box, one per take

Then Each value is transcribed at the dictated value, with the classic confusions absent

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per item checks below (U1): numbers exact and in order, drug and dose matched as one bounded pair, boundaries on every numeric entry, occurrences 1. Any changed, dropped or added value fails; format per Q1. Engine per take as S01. Every failure quoted

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Not judged yet: tricky numbers (teens vs tens, decimals, thousands) are blocked on the same OpenAI key approval.

Evidence: allure-results/1acedef8…: same key precondition block. Self-test 2/2.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-23/S01; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

How it is tested (aicheck-dictation/plan.json, automatable: yes): live, items B-01..B-08 in both contexts through the S01 flow. — Key precondition only.

Detail:

laneB-preconditions not met: the local OPENAI_API_KEY ends …PUMA and there is no OK on record from Quinn that it is not the key dev uses (her 2026-10-09 notes say it may be), so no audio was sent to OpenAI. The scripted self-test behind this entry ran before the review fix and used the real prepareSession: each take minted one OpenAI client secret (client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on api.openai.com) with the local key …PUMA — no audio, but the gated key was used.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions)..
